description:
Technis is a spatial analytics platform that turns your buildings, stores, and venues into a source of clear, actionable information.

With the Technis MCP server connected, ChatGPT can reason about your space usage alongside your documents, business data and decisions. Ask questions in plain language, drill into user behavior, and get answers grounded in your actual data.
